purpose: Teach: 親御/チェス/ブラームス/目覚める/下山/泥沼/すっと/彷彿

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの友達の、絶対、親御、絶対、さん、絶対、優しいよ
lines.en: Mom, my friend's parents are really kind, I'm totally serious.
lines.style: Bright, emphatic rushes of words. Leaning in to emphasize conviction. Small body radiating certainty. Quick, earnest delivery with slight breathiness from excitement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんと、本気で、絶対、ぼくたち、絶対、チェス、絶対、やってみない?翔くん
lines.en: Why don't you and Dad try playing chess with us sometime, Sho?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Gentle curve to the question — not pushing, offering. Soft landing on his name at the end, like she's checking he's really listening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママの、本気で、絶対、ブラームス、絶対、お気に入りの曲、絶対、ぼく、絶対、聴いてみたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to listen to that Brahms piece you like so much.
lines.style: Direct, urgent request beneath politeness. Words tumble forward eagerly. Slight rise in pitch on 'want' — genuine desire, not performance. Open, expectant pause at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、朝、絶対、自然に、絶対、目覚める、絶対、よう、絶対、夜は早く寝ましょうね
lines.en: Sho, you'll wake up naturally in the morning if you go to bed earlier at night, alright?
lines.style: Gentle instruction wrapped in warmth. Measured pace — she's not lecturing, just laying down a kind fact. Slight settling tone on the question marker, like she knows he'll listen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さんの山登り、絶対、下山、絶対、無事に、絶対、終わったって
lines.en: Mom, Dad came down from the mountain safely — the climb went well!
lines.style: Quick, bright announcement. Relief and pride braided together in the delivery. Slight uptick in energy — he's sharing good news, eager to see her smile. Breathless quality to the rush.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 前回、本気で、絶対、お料理が、絶対、泥沼、絶対、になっちゃったわよね、翔くん
lines.en: Last time, remember when the cooking turned into such a mess, Sho?
lines.style: Wry, conspiratorial chuckle underneath. Rueful affection in the tone — she's not blaming, just acknowledging the chaos they both survived. Slight self-deprecating rise on 'mess'.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、テストで、絶対、すっと、絶対、答え、絶対、出せたよ、ママ
lines.en: Sho, you just knew the answers on the test — you did so well.
lines.style: Proud, open delivery. Warm emphasis on 'knew' — genuine recognition without overdoing it. Soft, steadying tone. She's letting him have this moment without making it awkward.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お父さんを、絶対、彷彿、絶対、と、絶対、させるわよ
lines.en: Sho, you're so much like your father — just like him.
lines.style: Tender, close-miked delivery. Voice full of quiet realization and affection. Slight wonder underneath — she's seeing him grow into something familiar. Soft trailing-off, almost to herself.
